name: Dark and Distant
description: A 5 kHz high cut: pushes a part back and darkens it.

name: Rumble and Hiss
description: 50 Hz and 12 kHz: takes rumble and hiss away and leaves the program.

name: Small Radio
description: 1 kHz to 4 kHz: a tinny little radio speaker.

name: Telephone
description: 500 Hz to 3 kHz: a voice down a telephone line.

name: Thin Out
description: A 250 Hz low cut: clears the low end out of a part that does not need it.

name: Vocal Cleanup
description: 100 Hz and 15 kHz: takes handling noise and air hiss off a voice.
